name: MnSi
notes: Classic B20 helimagnet; first observed skyrmion lattice (Mühlbauer et al. 2009)

name: Gd2PdSi3
notes: Triangular lattice; Kurumaji et al. 2019. Small skyrmions stabilized by RKKY without DMI.

name: Gd3Ru4Al12
notes: Hirschberger et al. 2019 — skyrmion lattice in a centrosymmetric crystal.

name: GdRu2Si2
notes: Khanh et al. 2020 — among the smallest centrosymmetric skyrmions reported.

name: FeGe
notes: Near-room-temperature skyrmion host; Yu et al. 2011
